dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long have you been unwell?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: About three days. I have had fever and a cough.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The highest temperature we measured was thirty nine point one degrees.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: You did not eat much dinner yesterday either.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: That is true. I have not had much appetite.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Is the cough dry or are you bringing up mucus?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: We gave paracetamol last night when the fever became high.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: But you were sweating during the night.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Any shortness of breath or chest pain?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No chest pain and my breathing is okay.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will listen to your lungs and check your temperature and oxygen level.
